posts.body: So im new to rpg maker mz and all of the rpg maker franchise and im using to learn game design and things like that and im on the final boss rn and im trying to make it so when he reaches 50% hp the player does a qte to deal dmg to him and i want to make this happen 5 times to kill him so he as 50K hp total then when he is at 25k i need 5 qte to kill him but i cant seem to understand how to make a qte and ive tried using a addon but it doesnt work for me

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
If you want people to take some time to help you, it's worth you taking a bit of effort to format your post.
Many people are not going to bother trying to read a big block of text with no punctuation, sentences, or line breaks, and with incorrect spellings.
Aside from that, just saying you've tried using an addon (the correct term is plugin) and it doesn't work tells us nothing. You need to tell us
which
plugin you used (please include a link) and
how
it didn't work.
Nothing happening is very different from it crashing your game with an error message. And providing screenshots of how you tried to make it work in your project will help even more.
Good luck!
